title: In-match emoji tray
one_line: The 8-slot emote loadout, opened from the left button of the match action bar.

anatomy.spec: None. This is a tray, not a popup - the board must stay visible and playable underneath. Dim nothing.
Small NX Card (rim 6, rivets - bible 5.4 small card variant), 356 wide, slides up from the action bar. Bottom edge tucks behind the action bar so it reads as drawn out of it.
4 x 2 wells (bible 5.6), 72 pt square, 10 pt gap. Each holds one emote at 56 pt. The 8 slots are the player's loadout, set on the pre-match card.
A + well in the option amber kind at the end of the grid. Opens the shop's EMOJIS tab. Only shown when the player has fewer than 8 equipped or owns unequipped emotes.
Tapping the emoji button again, tapping the board, or firing an emote closes the tray. No close X - a tray is not a popup (bible 5.9).

states: Cooling down - every slot goes to the disabled kind and the tray shows 'Wait 3s'. Do not just lower the alpha (bible 5.8).
Fewer than 8 owned - empty slots render as plain wells with a faded + and open the shop.
Emotes off in Settings - the emoji button in the action bar is hidden entirely, not disabled.
motion: Open: slide up 120 pt over 200 ms, ease-out-back with a small overshoot.
Fire: the chosen slot punches to 1.15 over 90 ms, the tray closes, and the emote bubble rises from the sender's player card, holds 1.4 s, fades over 200 ms.
Cooldown: 3 s. A sweeping radial wipe over each well shows the time left.
data: Loadout of 8: the player's equipped emotes, set on the pre-match card. Local today; server-owned once the shop is real.
Mute list: per-match, local, cleared when the match ends. A muted player's emotes never render at all.

assets_needed.name: Emote set
assets_needed.prompt: BLOCKER: the emotes already in Assets/Art/UI/Emotes and Assets/Art/UI/MatchSetup/Emoji have no recorded source. Before any emote is sold or shipped, confirm the licence (IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md section 7.5). Noto and Twemoji are CC BY 4.0, Fluent is MIT, Apple's is not licensable. If the source cannot be confirmed, replace them with the NX Mascot pack.

do_not: Do not dim the board. The match keeps running while the tray is open.
Do not give the tray a close X or a scrim - it is a tray, not a popup.
Do not let the tray cover the board's centre cross or the dice tray.
Do not skip the 3 s cooldown. Emote spam is the fastest way to make a Ludo game unpleasant.
Do not render a muted player's emote at all - not faded, not silent. Nothing.
acceptance: Tray opens and closes from the action bar's left button and never covers the board centre or the dice.
Firing an emote shows a bubble over the sender's player card for 1.4 s.
The 3 s cooldown visibly locks every slot and counts down.
Muting a player stops their emotes appearing for the rest of the match.
With emotes turned off in Settings, the action bar's emoji button is gone.
steps: 1. Preflight per SHARED_RULES.md section 2. Raise the emote licence question as a BLOCKER in AI_HANDOFF.md if it is still unanswered - the tray can be built, but nothing ships until it is settled.
2. Build the tray prefab from the small-card chassis with a 4 x 2 well grid.
3. Wire it to the action bar's left button: open, close on second tap, close on board tap.
4. Implement fire: slot punch, tray close, bubble over the sender's card, 1.4 s hold.
5. Implement the 3 s cooldown with the radial wipe and the disabled kind.
6. Implement mute: a per-match list, reachable from the long-press on a player card, cleared at match end.
7. Hide the action bar's emoji button when emotes are off in Settings.
8. Capture open, cooling-down and fired states at 1080 x 2400. Postflight.
prompt:
Build the in-match emoji tray for Ludo NX.

Read SCREEN_PLANS/specs/SHARED_RULES.md, SCREEN_PLANS/specs/MATCH_HUD_V2.md section 3.4, and this file. Use only values from UI_BIBLE/tokens.json.

It is a TRAY, not a popup: no scrim, no close X, the board stays visible and the match keeps running underneath. It slides up out of the action bar's left button, on a small NX Card chassis (rim 6, rivets), holding the player's 8 equipped emotes in a 4 x 2 grid of wells, plus a + slot that opens the shop's EMOJIS tab.

The two things that make or break it: a 3 second cooldown between emotes (shown as a radial wipe, with slots in the disabled kind, not just faded), and a mute that makes a player's emotes not render at all. Emote spam is the fastest way to ruin a casual Ludo match.

Before building, post your component list and flag the emote licence question - the art in Assets/Art/UI/Emotes has no recorded source and nothing can ship until that is settled (IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md section 7.5).

Follow the 'steps' array in this file. Finish with bible section 11 and the 'acceptance' list.
